verdict.rationale: Gusto's core payroll product is inherently schedule-based (regular pay schedules, next-day/2-day/4-day processing, multi-location schedules) and webhooks let developers trigger downstream automation on events like payroll.paid, giving some recurring-workflow capability, but there is no evidence of a general-purpose job/workflow scheduler that an AI agent could use to configure arbitrary recurring automations beyond payroll itself. Missing for 10: a documented scheduling/automation API or cron-like mechanism for recurring workflows, and any AI-native example of setting up recurring jobs via the MCP server or API.
